business.about: Polycab is India’s leading manufacturers of cables and wires and allied products such as uPVC conduits and lugs and glands. We have a range of cables and wires for practically every application. More recently Polycab has also launched a wide range of consumer electrical products like Fans, Switches, Switchgear, LED lights and Luminaries, Solar Inverters, and Pumps.

results.read: Revenue +53% YoY; EBITDA margin compressed 140 bps YoY to 14%; PAT +43% YoY.

calls: Heavy capex under way: CWIP is 35% of fixed assets
Strong cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is 1.01× reported profit

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.

items.speaker: Niyant Maru
items.quote: In India, the Monetary Policy Committee, MPC, unanimously raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.5% and shifted the policy stance from neutral to calibrated tightening, implying interest rate cuts are not anticipated in the near term.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: And with that, the kind of capex that UltraTech has put into this industry, the kind of revenue guidance that they have given close to around potential of around 6x to 7x, it looks elusive at the moment.

items.speaker: Niyant Maru
items.quote: The IMF, in its latest outlook, has raised India's growth outlook by 60 basis points despite higher global energy prices, citing stronger economic momentum, robust services activity, and sustained domestic demand.

items.speaker: Niyant Maru
items.quote: Domestically, GDP growth for Q1 FY 2027 came in at 7.8%, underscoring the resilience of the economy despite an increasingly uncertain external backdrop.

items.speaker: Aditya Nathany
items.quote: The EPC segment reported revenues of INR 6,171 million in Q2 FY27, representing a healthy year-on-year growth of 53%.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: And of course, the ambition is that on a full year basis, we should be able to reach 8% to 10% of EBITDA margins on FMEG.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: But on top line basis, like we' have guided, whatever the market growth will deliver 1.5x to 2x of that growth.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: And profitability, like you mentioned, we have always guided that Bharat Net, which again forms part of our EPC business, the expected margins are supposed to be high single digits.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: But if you look back, like I mentioned, overall full year FY26, we did 18% volume growth.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Polycab India Limited May 06, 2026 In FMEG, we are also progressing well consistently, outpacing industry growth in line with our target of growing at 1.5x to 2x of market rate, while maintaining a clear focus on margin expansion and progressing towards our EBITDA margin goal of 8% to 10% by FY2030.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter stood at 4.1%, in line with our Project Spring trajectory of achieving 8% to 10% EBITDA margins by financial year 2030.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: So again, that's a very calibrated guidance which we have given that over long term, we should expect 11% to 13% EBITDA margin.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: And this is an improvement of approximately 300 basis points to 400 basis points over FY25 levels of market share of 26-27%.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: We also increased our dividend payout to approximately 27.2%, up from 26.3% last year as we move steadily towards our stated objective of exceeding 30% by FY 2030.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Within the Wires & Cable segment, growth since the launch of this program has consistently exceeded our guidance, tracking at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth with margins remaining far above the guided range.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Looking ahead, we are confident in the long-term potential of the FMEG segment and remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30, positioning the business for sustained growth and value creation.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: Control cables at an industry level, the salience will be somewhere around 15% to 20%, whereas flexible cables, the salience will be between 10% to 15%.

items.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
items.quote: Government capex surged nearly 28.2% YoY in the first 8 months of FY26 reaching ₹ 6.6 trillion versus ₹ 5.1 trillion last year, also 12.4% higher than in the 8-month period in FY24.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: And every year going ahead now, we believe that FMEG will continue to improve its profitability towards the guided range of 8% to 10% by FY30.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: Since you've been following this sector for many years, you will recall that even in FY22, similar commodity price inflations were there, where copper had gone up by 40%, whereas aluminium has gone up by almost 25%-27%.

items.speaker: Niyant Maru
items.quote: At the same time, government capital expenditure has accelerated meaningfully with approximately 59% of the FY26 capex outlay already utilized by November 2025, a 28% YoY increase.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: In FMEG, we continue to outpace industry growth in line with our plan of growing 1.5x to 2x the market rate, while maintaining focus on margin improvement and progressing towards the 8%-10% EBITDA target by FY 2030.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: For FY 2025, we raised our dividend payout to 26.3% from 25.5% last year, in line with our goal of crossing 30% dividend payout by FY 2030.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: Achal, the guidance of 11% to 13% of margins is a 5-year guidance.

items.speaker: Gandharv Tongia
items.quote: Meanwhile, government capex remains strong, growing 43% YoY till August '25 with ~38% of the FY 2026 outlay already spent.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: While the capex to GDP ratio remains below its historical peak of ~35% in 2004 to 2008, currently standing at 30%, the outlook continues to improve.

items.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
items.quote: Our International business continued its steady growth trajectory, recording a 25% YoY increase during the quarter and contributing 6.5% to consolidated revenue.
